location_change.from_location: Beijing Capital International Airport (北京首都国际机场), Shunyi District, Beijing
location_change.to_location: Lijiang Sanyi Airport (丽江三义机场), Gucheng District, Lijiang
location_change.departure_point_local: 北京首都国际机场T3航站楼
location_change.notes_base: Direct flight, 3h50m. Depart 07:00, arrive 10:50, allowing afternoon exploration of Lijiang Old Town. Airport to Old Town by taxi/DiDi: ~30km, 50-60min, approx. CNY 80-120. Alternative: CA1459 departing 16:45 arriving 20:30 if early morning is too rushed. Book 4-6 weeks in advance. Check-in closes 60 min before departure. Baggage allowance: 23kg checked + 8kg carry-on per person (Air China standard). Data source: duffel_flights
location_change.notes_local: 直飞航班，飞行时间约3小时50分钟。07:00出发，10:50抵达丽江，下午可游览丽江古城。机场到古城打车约30公里，50-60分钟，约80-120元。备选航班：CA1459，16:45出发，20:30到达。建议提前4-6周预订。航班信息来源：duffel_flights

route_1.name_base: Lijiang Sanyi Airport to Lijiang Old Town
route_1.name_local: 丽江三义机场 → 丽江古城
route_1.notes_base: There is also an airport bus (机场大巴) to Lijiang downtown for ~CNY 20-25 per person. Bus takes about 45-60 minutes. Taxi recommended for convenience with luggage. Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 也有机场大巴到丽江市区，约20-25元/人，车程45-60分钟。携带行李建议打车更方便。数据来源：gaode_maps

location_change.from_location: Lijiang Railway Station (丽江站), Gucheng District, Lijiang
location_change.to_location: Dali Railway Station (大理站), Dali City
location_change.cost_type_base: Second class seat, per person (approx. CNY 100)
location_change.notes_base: High-speed train (动车) from Lijiang to Dali, approximately 2 hours journey. Recommended afternoon departure (around 13:00-14:00) to allow morning exploration of Lijiang. Check 12306.cn for current schedules and exact train numbers (D-series trains). Second class: ~CNY 100/person; First class: ~CNY 150/person. Lijiang Station to Lijiang Old Town: 30km, ~50 min by taxi (CNY 60-80). Dali Station to Dali Old Town: 18.5km, ~30-40 min by taxi (CNY 40-60). Alternative: long-distance bus from Lijiang Bus Terminal (丽江客运站) to Dali Fast Bus Terminal (大理快速汽车客运站), ~3 hours, CNY 80-100/person. Data source: gaode_maps
location_change.notes_local: 丽江至大理动车，全程约2小时。建议下午出发（约13:00-14:00），上午游览丽江。具体班次请在12306.cn查询（D字头动车）。二等座约100元/人，一等座约150元/人。丽江站到丽江古城约30公里，打车约50分钟，费用60-80元。大理站到大理古城约18公里，打车约30-40分钟，费用40-60元。备选：丽江客运站到大理快速汽车客运站长途汽车，约3小时，80-100元/人。数据来源：gaode_maps

route_1.name_base: Dali Railway Station to Dali Old Town
route_1.notes_base: Local buses also available but slower with luggage. Taxi strongly recommended for evening arrival. Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 有公交车但携带行李不方便。晚间到达建议打车。数据来源：gaode_maps

route_1.name_base: Dali Old Town to Shuanglang Ancient Town (Erhai Lake Circuit)
route_1.name_local: 大理古城 → 双廊古镇（环洱海）
route_1.type_local: 电动车租赁（推荐）或打车/滴滴
route_1.departure_point_base: Dali Old Town or Erhai Lake East Road starting point
route_1.departure_point_local: 大理古城或洱海东路起点
route_1.arrival_point_base: Shuanglang Ancient Town (via Erhai Lake circuit route)
route_1.arrival_point_local: 双廊古镇（经环洱海路线）
route_1.cost_type_base: E-bike rental: ~CNY 60-80/day per bike; Car charter: ~CNY 200-300/day
route_1.cost_type_local: 电动车租赁：约60-80元/天/辆；包车：约200-300元/天
route_1.notes_base: Erhai Lake circuit (环洱海) total distance approximately 130km. Three recommended transport options: (1) E-bike rental (most popular for couples): CNY 60-80/day, allows flexible stops at scenic points along the lake. (2) Car/taxi charter (包车): CNY 200-300/day, more comfortable. (3) DiDi to Shuanglang directly: ~CNY 80 one way. Shuanglang (双廊) to Dali Old Town: 52.7km, ~74 min by car. Route: Dali Old Town → Erhai Park → Xizhou (喜洲) → Shuanglang → return via east shore. Allow full day (8:00-18:00). Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 洱海全程约130公里。三种推荐交通方式：(1)租电动车（情侣最受欢迎）：60-80元/天/辆，可随时停靠拍照赏景；(2)包车：200-300元/天，更舒适；(3)直接打滴滴到双廊：约80元单程。双廊到大理古城约52.7公里，开车约74分钟。推荐路线：大理古城→洱海公园→喜洲→双廊→沿东岸返回。建议全天游览（8:00-18:00）。数据来源：gaode_maps

location_change.from_location: Dali Fengyi Airport (大理凤仪机场), Fengyi Town, Dali City
location_change.to_location: Beijing Capital International Airport (北京首都国际机场), Shunyi District, Beijing
location_change.notes_base: Direct flight, 3h25m. Depart 19:30, arrive 22:55 Beijing time. Afternoon/evening departure allows full morning in Dali Old Town. Dali Old Town to Dali Airport: ~24.4km, ~60 min by taxi (CNY 60-80), depart hotel no later than 16:30. Alternative if morning flight preferred: CA1500 departing 09:55, arriving 13:25 - but this cuts short the last morning in Dali. Check-in closes 60 min before departure. Baggage: 23kg checked + 8kg carry-on per person. Book 4-6 weeks in advance. Data source: duffel_flights
location_change.notes_local: 直飞航班，飞行时间约3小时25分钟。19:30出发，22:55抵达北京。下午/晚间出发可充分游览大理上午时光。大理古城到大理凤仪机场约24公里，打车约60分钟，约60-80元，建议不晚于16:30离开酒店。备选：CA1500，09:55出发，13:25抵达北京，但会缩短在大理的最后上午时间。建议提前4-6周预订。数据来源：duffel_flights
